xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
'1. The above un-audited Financial Results of the Company have been prepared in accordance with the guidelines issued by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) and the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules 2015 (Ind As) prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 and other recognized accounting practices and policies to the extent applicable.
'2. The above Un-audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September,2026 have been reviewed by the Audit Committtee and approved by the Board of Directors of the Company at their respectives meetings held on 14th October, 2026. The Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 have been subjected to limited review by the Statutory Auditors, who have expressed an Unmodified Opinion.
'3. In compliance with Regulation 33 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the Limited Review of the Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026, has been carried out by M/s. Dharmendra K. Agarwal & Co., the erstwhile Statutory Auditors of the Company, in accordance with SEBI Circular No. CIR/CFD/CMD1/114/2019 dated 18th October, 2019.
'4.The Preferential Allotment Committee, at its meeting held on 16th June, 2026, allotted 8,85,00,000 warrants on a preferential basis to 19 investors, who paid 25% of the issue price upfront.
Subsequently, upon receipt of the balance 75% of the issue price, the Preferential Allotment Committee allotted 8,85,00,000 equity shares upon conversion of warrants against receipt of the aggregate balance consideration of Rs.18,58,50,000.
Consequent upon the aforesaid allotments, the issued, subscribed and paid-up equity share capital of the Company stands increased to Rs.23,10,00,000/-, comprising 23,10,00,000 fully paid-up equity shares of face value Re. 1/- each.
'5.The Company has only one segment i.e. Finance services for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. Therefore, there is no requirement of segment reporting for the above mentioned period.
'6.An amount of Rs.42.37 lakhs, representing fees and commission income, was classified under “Other Income” in the financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. In the financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the corresponding figure for the previous quarter ended June 30, 2026, has been regrouped under the “Fees and Commission Income” head for appropriate presentation. This regrouping is purely presentational in nature and has no impact on the profit or loss of the Company or its overall financial performance. The regrouping has been made solely for the purpose of appropriate classification of income.
7.The earnings per share (basic and diluted) for the Interim Period have not been annualized.
8.The Statement of Assets & Liabilities as at September, 30, 2026 is annexed with the financial results along with the Cash Flow Statements.
9. The figures of previous period/year have been re-stated/re-grouped/re-arranged/re-classified wherever necessary.
10.The aforesaid unaudited financial results will be uploaded on the Company’s website www.vijifinance.com and will also be available on the website of the Stock Exchanges (www.bseindia.com , www.nseindia.com and www.cse-india.com) for the benefit of shareholders and investors. Further, publication containing a Quick Response code and the details of the webpage where complete financial results of the Company are available, will be published in English and Hindi Newspapers with in prescribed time limit.
